name: nexql-mcp
description: Standalone Postgres MCP server with schema-aware tooling, offline index, and read-only defaults.
long_description: NexQL MCP connects to PostgreSQL over stdio, exposes catalog/monitoring/index tools, and uses a local schema index so agents stop hallucinating table names. Prefer a least-privilege DB role (e.g. GRANT pg_read_all_data).

database_url.title: Database URL
database_url.description: Postgres connection string (postgres://user:pass@host:5432/dbname). Also accepted as argv to nexql-mcp.
